messages.subject: Mining & Industrial Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Xtrava Group Team,

Your global leadership recruitment across mining, industrial technology, engineered products and construction materials aligns closely with my profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional appointments where mining or industrial growth requires sophisticated stakeholder leadership, regulatory coordination and responsible execution. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
